---
title: "Life Expectancy and Population"
---

This page analyses the relationship between life expectancy and population across countries over time.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
gap <- read.csv("gapminder.csv")
ggplot(gap, aes(x=population_millions, y=life_expectancy, color=continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(
    x = "Population (millions, log scale)",
    y = "Life Expectancy",
    color = "Continent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
